language: Short guides. Open any guide to replay it.
phone.title: Import phone contacts
linkedin.title: Import LinkedIn connections
tickle.title: Create your first tickle
groups.title: Organize people into groups
phone.1.title: Your people, already here
phone.1.body: Start with the contacts on your phone. Your Ticklr network stays on this device.
phone.2.title: Bring in your contacts
phone.2.body: Choose individual people with the contact picker, or import all contacts Ticklr can access.
android.phone.2.body: Tap {importPhone} and allow contacts access when Android asks. Ticklr imports the contacts it can access.
phone.3.title: Make your first connection
phone.3.body: Find your imported people in Network. Open a profile to create a tickle or add someone to a group.
linkedin.1.title: Keep connections warm
linkedin.1.body: Bring professional connections into Ticklr using your LinkedIn connections CSV.
linkedin.2.title: Start with your export
linkedin.2.body: Request your connections data from LinkedIn and save the downloaded CSV on your phone. The import screen has the export instructions.
linkedin.3.title: One file, a familiar network
linkedin.3.body: Choose your connections CSV. After import, find your connections in Network and add any missing contact details.
tickle.1.title: A little reminder to reconnect
tickle.1.body: Open a profile and tap {createTickle} to set a reminder to reconnect.
tickle.2.title: Pick a rhythm or a special date
tickle.2.body: Choose a frequency and starting date. For a birthday, choose Birthday and set the date; the tickle repeats annually.
tickle.3.title: Remember the little things
tickle.3.body: Add a note, then save. Find your reminder on the profile and in the {tickleTab} tab.
groups.1.title: A place for every circle
groups.1.body: Keep family, friends, and work connections together in groups.
groups.2.title: Put your people together
groups.2.body: Open a profile, find {groupsTab}, and choose {addToGroup}. Select a group to add the person. A person can belong to more than one group.
groups.3.title: Your circles, your way
groups.3.body: Use the plus button in Groups to create your own circle, then choose its members.
